shortDescription: Returns information related to your Account settings.

options.name: backups_enabled
options.description: Account-wide backups default. If true, all Linodes created will automatically be enrolled in the Backups service. If false, Linodes will not be enrolled by default, but may still be enrolled on creation or later.

options.name: maintenance_policy
options.description: The Slug of the maintenance policy associated with the account.

options.name: network_helper
options.description: Enables network helper across all users by default for new Linodes and Linode Configs.
